title: Regulatory frameworks
description: AWA (USDA-APHIS), PHS Policy (OLAW), the Guide, AAALAC, FDA GLP (21 CFR 58), Ag Guide, USDA pain categories B–E.

title: IACUC
description: Composition (AWA min 3 vs PHS min 5), semiannual program review & facility inspection, designated member review (DMR) vs full committee review (FCR), quorum, protocol suspension, Institutional Official role, animal use protocol (AUP).

title: Facility operations
description: Biosafety cabinet classes I/II/III, fume hood vs BSC, positive vs negative pressure rooms, facility security, disaster/contingency planning.

title: The 3Rs
description: Replacement, Reduction, Refinement (Russell & Burch, 1959).

title: Macroenvironment
description: Temperature ranges, relative humidity 30–70%, air changes 10–15 ACH, light intensity (≤325 lux for albino rodents), 12:12 light cycle, noise <85 dB.

title: Caging & space
description: Cage height minimums, floor-area requirements, individually ventilated (IVC) vs static caging, microenvironment vs macroenvironment.

title: Sanitation
description: Sanitize vs disinfect vs sterilize, 180°F (82.2°C) final rinse, autoclave 121°C/15 psi/15 min, biological indicators (Geobacillus stearothermophilus).

title: Nutrition & feed
description: Diet types (natural-ingredient, purified, chemically defined, certified, autoclavable, irradiated), milling date & shelf life, storage.

title: Daily husbandry
description: Animal identification, cage cards, records, environmental enrichment, quarantine & acclimation, SPF status.

title: Species: mice
description: Strains, breeding, postpartum estrus, handling, common diseases, Whitten/Bruce/Lee-Boot effects.

title: Species: rats
description: Gestation, ringtail, strains, absence of gallbladder, inability to vomit (non-emesis).

title: Species: small rodents
description: Hamster (solitary, ~16-day gestation), gerbil (spontaneous seizures, ventral scent gland), guinea pig (dietary Vitamin C requirement, dystocia).

title: Species: rabbits
description: Induced ovulator, GI stasis, calcium metabolism, cecotrophy, Pasteurella (snuffles), proper restraint.

title: Species: NHPs
description: Herpes B virus (Macacine herpesvirus 1), TB palpebral testing, 6-week quarantine, social housing, PPE.

title: Species: other
description: Dog/cat/swine (3-3-3 rule)/ruminants/ferrets; fish/birds/amphibians/reptiles.

title: Occupational health & safety
description: Laboratory animal allergy (LAA) prevalence & allergens, zoonoses, vaccinations, hierarchy of controls, respiratory protection.

title: Genetics
description: Inbred/outbred/F1 hybrid/congenic/transgenic/knockout, standardized nomenclature.

title: Anesthesia
description: Isoflurane, anesthetic depth (pedal withdrawal reflex), physiologic monitoring.

title: Euthanasia
description: AVMA Guidelines (2020), CO2 displacement 30–70%/min, cervical dislocation (<200 g), verification of death.

title: Research techniques
description: Injection routes, oral gavage, blood-volume limits, DEA controlled-substance schedules, experimental design, unit conversions.
